A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified: Fixed 2026-11-25, before any result (Rule 22, #758). Baseline description of the shipped settings at track-p 815e2bba: one arm (ship), classes-18, normal world, 100,000 turns, evidence not retained. The shipped game changed materially since the last measured pin 52fff0de (prepared_dl2_min_hp 30 to 0; the loop window shipped at 16/3; caution_rising_skip_held_stairs, defend_prep_mana_starved, recover_mana_rest_full_hp, attack_throw_surplus 1/100, explore_mix_depth_adjusted_level and light_first_cast_require_dark shipped on; desperate-caution keys shipped off; the item_test_unknown block removed) - this run describes the new shipped game and anchors future studies; it compares against nothing. Gate: no config_error; one binary; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped. Progress endpoint CL5 reached by 100,000 turns - known attainment out of all starts, deaths, unfinished and alive at the cutoff with CL5 reported separately; DL3/DL5 and median first-turn-at-level-5 as diagnostics. Descriptive (RULES 14); the ladder (verysmall, small-rest, medium) is the owner's later call.
